$comment: Re-mine status per source. The status is a JUDGEMENT and is authored: whether a source has been read to exhaustion under the MINING.md rule cannot be computed. How many rows it carries CAN be, so it is not stored here — doc_counts.py counts filed rows in data/observations/ and renders the tables in docs/MIGRATION-STATE.md. An authored count went stale the first time a source was properly re-mined. validate.py errors if a cited source is missing from this file or carries an unknown status.

statuses.not-started: Rows exist from an earlier pass. NOT verified against the paper; assume incomplete.
statuses.scaffolded: An extraction file was generated from existing rows. Still not checked against the paper.
statuses.remined: Read from the source in full under the MINING.md rule. Everything filed or parked.
statuses.verified: A second pass confirmed the re-mine missed nothing.
statuses.blocked-no-source: No local copy. Cannot be re-mined until acquired.
statuses.not-a-row-source: Assessed and yields no attachment rows. No re-mine needed.

fisher-goodman-1955.note: 111 muscles: 43 filed, 50 parked. See its reading note.

fritzsch-2023.note: Open on Preprints.org (doi 10.20944/preprints202306.0416.v1) but the download endpoint blocks scripted requests; fetch in a browser.

navarro-etal-2023.note: Closed access (OpenAlex: closed). Needs a subscription or an author copy.

osawa-1898.note: First re-mine pass 2026-08-19: the four Kaumuskeln parked on `occupied` — Haas (1973) already holds the Sphenodon cranial rows and the schema allows one row per record per species. Axial, neck and the nerve section still untouched.

pereyra-etal-2024.note: In PMC (PMC11021681) but NOT in the PMC open-access subset, so no programmatic route. Free to read at the publisher; fetch in a browser.

russell-bauer-2008.note: First re-mine pass 2026-08-19: 277 comparative statements parked for the five genera with species records. None filed -- they are reported observations and need `after`. Seventeen further genera need species records first.

walker-1973.note: First re-mine pass done 2026-08-19: his six other dissected species added and 139 comparative statements parked. NOT `remined` — the muscle-by-muscle assignment of those statements, and the Trachemys rows themselves, are still unverified against the book.

walthall-ashley-ross-2006.note: Bronze OA on Wiley (free to read, no open licence). Wiley serves a bot-check page to scripted requests; fetch it in a browser.

widrig-etal-2026.note: 38 blocks: 20 filed, 16 parked, 2 folded. See its reading note.
